mapper.sql: services_terminate_reduces.id AS id, customers.id AS customerId, customers.name AS customerName, services.id AS serviceId, services_terminate_reduces.type AS type, CASE WHEN services_terminate_reduces.type = 1 THEN 'Reduce' WHEN services_terminate_reduces.type = 2 THEN 'Terminate' ELSE '' END AS typeName, services_terminate_reduces.date AS date, services_terminate_reduce_details.status AS status, services_terminate_reduces.reasons AS reason, services_terminate_reduces.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, services_terminate_reduces.modified AS modified, IF(EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM customer_history_print_tracking chpt WHERE chpt.reference_id = services_terminate_reduces.id AND chpt.type IN(3,4) ), 'Ready', 'Not yet') AS printStatus, CONCAT(modifier.first_name, ' ', modifier.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM services_terminate_reduces LEFT JOIN services_terminate_reduce_details ON services_terminate_reduce_details.services_terminate_id = services_terminate_reduces.id INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = services_terminate_reduces.customer_id INNER JOIN services ON services.id = services_terminate_reduce_details.service_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON services_terminate_reduces.created_by = creator.id LEFT JOIN users AS modifier ON services_terminate_reduces.modified_by = modifier.id

SELECT qs.id AS id, qs.qty AS sku, sections.id AS sectionId, sections.name AS sectionName, services.id AS serviceId, services.name AS serviceName, services.unit_price AS unitPrice, services.description AS description FROM quotations LEFT JOIN quotation_services qs
ON qs.quotation_id = quotations.id
LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = qs.service_id LEFT JOIN sections ON sections.id = services.section_id
WHERE quotations.customer_id = #{customerId} AND services.is_active = 1 AND sections.is_active = 1 AND qs.id IN ( SELECT MAX(qs2.id) FROM quotation_services qs2 GROUP BY qs2.service_id ) GROUP BY qs.id ORDER BY qs.id DESC;
SELECT id FROM quotations WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT strd.service_id AS serviceId, SUM(strd.sku) AS sku FROM services_terminate_reduces str JOIN services_terminate_reduce_details strd ON str.id = strd.services_terminate_id WHERE str.customer_id = #{customerId} AND str.is_active = 1 AND strd.is_active = 1 AND strd.status = 1 GROUP BY strd.service_id

WHERE services.is_active = 1 AND services_terminate_reduces.id = #{id} GROUP BY services_terminate_reduces.id

SELECT services_terminate_reduce_details.id AS id, services_terminate_reduce_details.sku AS sku, services.id AS serviceId, services.name AS serviceName, services.unit_price AS unitPrice, services.description AS description, sections.id AS sectionId, sections.name AS sectionName, services_terminate_reduce_details.status AS status FROM services_terminate_reduce_details LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = services_terminate_reduce_details.service_id LEFT JOIN sections ON sections.id = services.section_id WHERE services_terminate_reduce_details.is_active = 1 AND services_terminate_reduce_details.status = 1 AND services_terminate_reduce_details.service_id IN (#{serviceId}) AND services_terminate_reduce_details.services_terminate_id = #{serviceTerminateId}
SELECT service_id FROM services_terminate_reduce_details WHERE services_terminate_id = #{id} AND is_active = 1;

mapper.update: UPDATE services_terminate_reduces SET company_id = #{service.companyId}, customer_id = #{service.customerId}, type = #{service.type}, date = #{service.date}, reasons = #{service.reason}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{service.modifiedBy}, is_active = #{service.isActive} WHERE id = #{service.id};
